thought.text: The frontend is fully functional — it serves the "Genehmigungsportal" shell (HTTP 200) with all 8 MFE + 8 injector dists. Now let me build the 4 standalone MFE images (mfe-ewm, mfe-fp, mfe-ws, shell) with the correct context:

reasoning_content:
The frontend is fully working — it serves the "Genehmigungsportal" shell (HTTP 200), and all the MFE dist and dist-injector directories are in place.

Next up are the sub-MFE images (mfe-ewm, mfe-fp, mfe-ws, shell). The earlier wave-B builds of these failed due to incorrect contexts. I'll build them now with the correct context (the context is 01-frontend, using -f for the MFE's Dockerfile). These Dockerfiles use `npm ci --workspace <mfe> --workspace shared --include-workspace-root=false` — which will work now that the lockfile is in sync.

I'll launch these four builds in the background (in a batch to avoid OOM), and also do the final image count and git diff summary in the meantime.

Actually, the sub-MFE Dockerfiles do a `COPY . .` and build — each one builds shared + one MFE (vite). Two parallel executions should be fine memory-wise.

action.command:
cat > /workspace/.build-logs/mfe_build.sh <<'MEOF'
#!/bin/bash
LOGS=/workspace/.build-logs
: > $LOGS/mfe-results
for mfe in mfe-ewm mfe-fp mfe-ws shell; do
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build -t "$mfe" -f "/workspace/01-frontend/$mfe/Dockerfile" /workspace/01-frontend >> "$LOGS/mfe-$mfe.log" 2>&1
  echo "$? $mfe" >> $LOGS/mfe-results
  echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] built $mfe rc=$?" >> $LOGS/mfe.log
done
echo DONE >> $LOGS/mfe.log
MEOF
chmod +x /workspace/.build-logs/mfe_build.sh && nohup /workspace/.build-logs/mfe_build.sh > /workspace/.build-logs/mfe.out 2>&1 & echo "MFE PID $!"
